title: Dual-Cavity Fabry-Perot Filter for Precise Band Control
scientific_hypothesis: A dual-cavity Fabry-Perot structure with two defect layers embedded in Bragg mirrors can independently tune transmission peaks at 4.15-4.35 μm and 4.55-4.75 μm while maintaining deep stopbands between and outside the passbands.
design_principle: Fabry-Perot cavities produce narrow transmission peaks at resonant wavelengths determined by cavity optical thickness. Two cavities with different thicknesses create two passbands. Bragg mirror stacks on both sides provide stopband rejection. This approach follows L09's 4-cavity F-P design adapted for dual-band transmission.
proposed_topology: Air | (Si/SiO2)_4 | Si_cavity1 | (SiO2/Si)_3 | Si_cavity2 | (SiO2/Si)_4 | Daimon-20 substrate, 22 coating layers total with two Si defect cavities
design_variables: thickness of first Si cavity layer
thickness of second Si cavity layer
thicknesses of all 20 mirror coating layers
soft_objectives: minimize transmittance in 3.60-4.00 μm and 4.85-5.20 μm stopbands
manufacturing_considerations: Cavity thickness precision critical for peak wavelength control
Si and SiO2 compatible with standard deposition
Daimon-20 substrate thermal expansion mismatch requires stress management
theory_basis: Fabry-Perot resonance condition for cavity transmission
Bragg mirror reflectivity for stopband formation
Dual-cavity coupling for independent band control per L09
expected_advantages: Precise control of each passband center wavelength via cavity thickness
Deep stopbands between passbands from mirror stacks
Established design methodology from L09 dual-channel filter
known_risks: Cavity coupling may cause passband splitting or shift
Mirror stack may not provide sufficient stopband width at band edges
22 layers approaches 24-layer limit leaving little margin
execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer dual-cavity Fabry-Perot stack on CaF2 (Daimon-20) substrate under air normal incidence. Stack structure: Air | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | SiO2 (Kischkat) | Si | CaF2 (Daimon-20). Layers 10 and 14 serve as cavity defects. Vary all 22 coating layer thicknesses independently with emphasis on cavity layers. Target transmission peaks at 4.15-4.35 μm and 4.55-4.75 μm. Target low transmittance at 3.60-4.00 μm, 4.35-4.55 μm, and 4.85-5.20 μm. No metal layers. Materials: si, SiO2 (Kischkat). Substrate: CaF2 (Daimon-20). Maximum 24 layers respected.
